recommended_path: MTÜ (non-profit association) via the e-Business Register for the low-cost, fully-remote route; sihtasutus (foundation) if a no-member endowment structure is needed
entity_types: MTÜ (mittekasumihandlusühing, non-profit association — 2+ members; the unified 2016 form replacing selts/ühing)
Sihtasutus (foundation — no members, mandatory management board (juhtkogu) + supervisory board (järelevaldekogu))

requirements.founders: MTÜ: min. 2 founding members (foreign nationals allowed). Sihtasutus: 1+ founder; boards must be appointed (management + supervisory)
requirements.local_presence: Registered office in Estonia (a virtual office / e-residency address suffices)
requirements.documents: MTÜ: articles of association + founding decision, filed online in the e-Business Register (ariregister.rik.ee) with Smart-ID/mobile-ID, or notarized for e-residents. Sihtasutus: foundation deed (notarial) + application; online filing via e-Residency possible

forms: e-Business Register online application (ariregister.rik.ee) for MTÜ
Sihtasutus: foundation deed (notarized) + e-Business Register application
Official MTÜ guide: https://e-resident.gov.ee (quasi-primary, government e-Residency portal)

fees.source: https://abiinfo.rik.ee/en/uudised/state-fees-will-change-01012022 — official state-fee table effective 01.01.2022: 'Non-profit association | 30 EUR | 10 EUR' (registration | amendment)
fees.note: Verified verbatim in the official Center of Registers and Information Systems table; links to the State Fees Act (riigiteataja.ee/eli/ee/506122021002)

fees.source: https://abiinfo.rik.ee/en/uudised/state-fees-will-change-01012022 — same table: 'Foundation | 80 EUR | 10 EUR'; corroborated by eesti.ee sihtasutus article
fees.note: Supersedes the stale historical ~2,600-kron (≈€330) figure — that figure is unverified and dropped
Market rate; the state fee does not include notarization

fees.item: e-Residency card (optional, for online signing by non-residents)
fees.note: Only needed if founders will not use Estonian ID/Smart-ID in person

fees.amount: e.g. eestifirma.ee €375-1,200 packages; mtyabi.ee service ~349 EUR incl. the 30 EUR state fee; legal address €149-298/yr
fees.note: Commercial convenience, not a legal requirement

timelines.sihtasutus: 5 business days (per eesti.ee, incl. notary step)

supersedes: Prior v2 'association needs min. 5 members' corrected: MTÜ needs 2+ members under the Non-profit Associations Act (the 5-member rule applied to the old ühing form, now absorbed into MTÜ).
Prior v2 'Registration fee ~€10-50' refined to exact primary figures: MTÜ 30 EUR, sihtasutus 80 EUR (official 01.01.2022 state-fee table, abiinfo.rik.ee).
Prior v2 'foundation needs a small endowment (~€2,600+)' dropped: no statutory minimum endowment found in the Estonian Foundations Act; the kron figure was unverified.
